translations.idiomatic: In youth he served the court as an inner tribute attendant and rose to inner provisioner.

sentences.zh: 晟襲位，任閹人林延遇為甘泉宮使，頗預政事。

translations.literal: When Sheng took the throne he appointed the eunuch Lin Yanyu as commissioner of Sweet Spring Palace, who took considerable part in government affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When Sheng seized the throne he appointed the eunuch Lin Yanyu commissioner of Sweet Spring Palace, who took a considerable role in government.

sentences.zh: 延遇病將死，言於晟曰：「臣死，惟龔澄樞可用。

translations.literal: When Yanyu fell ill and was about to die, he said to Sheng, "When your subject dies, only Gong Chengshu can be used.
translations.idiomatic: As Yanyu lay dying, he told Sheng, "When I am gone, only Gong Chengshu can serve you.

sentences.zh: 」即日擢知承宣院兼內侍省，改德陵使兼龍德宮使。

translations.literal: " That same day [Chengshu] was promoted to administer the Proclamation Court together with the Inner Attendant Service, and changed to commissioner of Virtue Tomb together with commissioner of Dragon Virtue Palace.
translations.idiomatic: " That same day Chengshu was made administrator of the Proclamation Court and the Inner Attendant Service, and commissioner of Virtue Tomb and Dragon Virtue Palace.

sentences.zh: 鋹嗣位，加特進、開府儀同三司、萬華宮使、驃騎大將軍，改上將軍、左龍虎軍觀軍容使、內太師，軍國之務皆決於澄樞。

translations.literal: When Chang succeeded, [Chengshu] was given special advancement, Grand Preceptor with the Golden Seal, commissioner of Myriad Splendor Palace, and General-in-Chief of Fast Cavalry; changed to General-in-Chief, observer of army appearance for the Left Dragon-Tiger Army, and Inner Grand Preceptor — military and state affairs were all decided by Chengshu.
translations.idiomatic: When Chang succeeded, Chengshu received special advancement, the rank of Grand Preceptor with the Golden Seal, and posts including commissioner of Myriad Splendor Palace and General-in-Chief of Fast Cavalry, then General-in-Chief, observer of the Left Dragon-Tiger Army, and Inner Grand Preceptor. All military and civil affairs were decided by Chengshu.

sentences.zh: 澄樞與李托、薛崇譽置酷法之具，民甚苦之。

translations.literal: Chengshu together with Li Tuo and Xue Chongyu set up instruments of cruel law, and the people suffered greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Chengshu, Li Tuo, and Xue Chongyu devised instruments of cruel punishment, and the people suffered terribly.

sentences.zh: 初，岩改名龔，有術者言不利，名龔，當敗國事，遂改名。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Yan changed his name to Gong, a practitioner of arts said it was inauspicious — the name Gong would ruin state affairs — and therefore he changed his name to [the invented character].
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Yan changed his name to Gong, a diviner said the name was ill-omened and would ruin the state, so he adopted his invented character instead.

sentences.zh: 後鋹用澄樞，以其姓卒亡其國，澄樞亦被誅。

translations.literal: Later Chang employed Chengshu; because of that surname he finally lost his state, and Chengshu was also executed.
translations.idiomatic: Later Chang employed Chengshu; because of that surname the state was lost, and Chengshu was executed as well.

sentences.zh: 李托，封州封川人。

translations.literal: Li Tuo was a man of Fengchuan in Feng prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Li Tuo was from Fengchuan in Feng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 少習騎射，以謹願事為內府局令。

translations.literal: In youth he studied riding and archery; with cautious willingness he served [the earlier ruler] as director of an inner palace bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He studied riding and archery in youth and, dutiful and compliant, served the court as director of an inner palace bureau.

sentences.zh: 晟襲位，遷內侍省內侍，充宮闈諸衛押番兼秀華宮使。

translations.literal: When Sheng took the throne, [Tuo] was transferred to inner attendant of the Inner Attendant Service, filling the post of palace inner-guard rotation commander together with commissioner of Splendid Bloom Palace.
translations.idiomatic: When Sheng took the throne, Tuo became an inner attendant and served as palace guard rotation commander and commissioner of Splendid Bloom Palace.

sentences.zh: 鋹立，改玩華宮使、內侍監兼列聖、景陽二宮使。

translations.literal: When Chang was established, [Tuo] was changed to commissioner of Play Bloom Palace, superintendent of inner attendants together with commissioner of the Two Palaces of Listed Sages and Sunny Vista.
translations.idiomatic: When Chang took the throne, Tuo became commissioner of Play Bloom Palace, superintendent of inner attendants, and commissioner of the Listed Sages and Sunny Vista palaces.

sentences.zh: 托納二女於鋹，鋹以其長為貴妃，次為美人，政事皆訪托而後行。

translations.literal: Tuo presented two daughters to Chang; Chang made the elder an honored consort and the younger a beauty — government affairs were all consulted with Tuo before action.
translations.idiomatic: Tuo presented two daughters to Chang, who made the elder an honored consort and the younger a beauty. All government affairs were referred to Tuo before action.

sentences.zh: 加特進、開府儀同三司、甘泉宮使兼六軍觀軍容使、行內中尉，遷驃騎上將軍、內太師。

translations.literal: He was given special advancement, Grand Preceptor with the Golden Seal, commissioner of Sweet Spring Palace together with observer of army appearance for the Six Armies, acting inner commandant of the palace, and promoted to General-in-Chief of Fast Cavalry and Inner Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: He received special advancement, the rank of Grand Preceptor with the Golden Seal, commissioner of Sweet Spring Palace and observer of the Six Armies, acting inner commandant, and was promoted to General-in-Chief of Fast Cavalry and Inner Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 太祖命師伐鋹，既克韶州，統軍使李承渥戰死，節度副使辛延渥間道遣人勸鋹降，托堅沮其議。

translations.literal: Taizu ordered the army to campaign against Chang; after Shao prefecture was taken, army commander Li Chenwo died in battle; deputy military commissioner Xin Yanwo sent men by a hidden route to urge Chang to surrender, but Tuo firmly obstructed the plan.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizu ordered the campaign against Chang and Shao Prefecture fell, Army Commander Li Chenwo was killed in battle. Deputy Commissioner Xin Yanwo sent envoys by a secret route urging surrender, but Tuo firmly blocked the plan.

sentences.zh: 及就擒至許田，太祖遣使問托等：「昨已約降，復率眾來拒戰，及軍敗又縱火焚府庫，誰為之謀也？

translations.literal: When [Chang] was captured and reached Xutian, Taizu sent envoys to question Tuo and the others: "Yesterday you had agreed to surrender, yet again led the masses to resist in battle, and after the army was defeated again set fires burning the treasuries — whose plan was this?
translations.idiomatic: After the capture at Xutian, Taizu sent envoys to question Tuo and the others: "You had agreed to surrender, yet led troops to resist again, and after defeat set fire to the treasuries. Whose counsel was this?

sentences.zh: 」托俯首不能對。

translations.literal: " Tuo bowed his head and could not answer.
translations.idiomatic: " Tuo bowed his head and could not answer.

sentences.zh: 鋹諫議大夫王珪謂托曰：「昔在廣州，機務並爾輩所專，火又自內起，今天子遣使案問，爾復欲推過何人？

translations.literal: Chang's remonstrance grandee Wang Gui said to Tuo, "Formerly in Guangzhou, state affairs were all monopolized by your sort, and the fire also rose from within — now the Son of Heaven sends envoys to investigate; upon whom do you wish to shift blame again?
translations.idiomatic: Chang's Remonstrance Grandee Wang Gui said to Tuo, "In Guangzhou you controlled all affairs of state, and the fire began within the palace. Now the Son of Heaven sends investigators — upon whom will you shift blame?

sentences.zh: 」遂唾而批其頰，托乃引伏，後至京斬之。

translations.literal: " He then spat and struck his cheek; Tuo thereupon confessed, and later when they reached the capital he was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: " He spat and struck Tuo's cheek. Tuo confessed, and was beheaded when they reached the capital.

sentences.zh: 薛崇譽，韶州曲江人。

translations.literal: Xue Chongyu was a man of Qujiang in Shao prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Chongyu was from Qujiang in Shao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 善《孫子五曹算》。

translations.literal: He was skilled in Sunzi's Five Offices Calculation.
translations.idiomatic: He was skilled in Sunzi's Five Offices Calculation.

sentences.zh: 晟署為內門使兼太倉使。

translations.literal: Sheng appointed him inner gate commissioner together with grand granary commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng appointed him inner gate commissioner and grand granary commissioner.

sentences.zh: 鋹嗣位，遷內中尉、特進、開府儀同三司、簽書點檢司事。

translations.literal: When Chang succeeded, [Chongyu] was transferred to inner commandant of the palace, special advancement, Grand Preceptor with the Golden Seal, and drafter for inspection of bureau affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When Chang succeeded, Chongyu became inner commandant, received special advancement and the rank of Grand Preceptor with the Golden Seal, and was made drafter for inspection of bureau affairs.

sentences.zh: 太祖命師克廣州，崇譽縱火焚倉廩，擒至京，與李托同戮。

translations.literal: Taizu ordered the army to take Guangzhou; Chongyu set fire and burned the granaries; captured and brought to the capital, he was executed together with Li Tuo.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizu's army took Guangzhou, Chongyu set fire to the granaries. Captured and brought to the capital, he was executed together with Li Tuo.

sentences.zh: 潘崇徹，廣州南海人。

translations.literal: Pan Chongche was a man of Nanhai in Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Chongche was from Nanhai in Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 事為內侍省局丞。

translations.literal: He served [the earlier ruler] as bureau assistant of the Inner Attendant Service.
translations.idiomatic: He served the court as a bureau assistant in the Inner Attendant Service.

sentences.zh: 頗讀兵書，立戰功。

translations.literal: He read military books considerably and achieved merit in battle.
translations.idiomatic: He studied military texts and won distinction in battle.

sentences.zh: 晟嘗遣大將吳懷恩伐桂州平之，懷恩為部下所殺，命崇徹代之。

translations.literal: Sheng once sent the great general Wu Huai'en to campaign against Gui prefecture and pacify it; Huai'en was killed by his subordinates, and Sheng ordered Chongche to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng once sent General Wu Huai'en to conquer Gui Prefecture. When Huai'en was killed by his own men, Sheng appointed Chongche in his place.

sentences.zh: 鋹襲位，加西北面都統。

translations.literal: When Chang took the throne, [Chongche] was given the additional post of commander-in-chief of the northwest sector.
translations.idiomatic: When Chang succeeded, Chongche was made commander-in-chief of the northwest sector.

sentences.zh: 歲餘，鋹頗疑崇徹，遣薛宗譽使其軍以察之。

translations.literal: After more than a year Chang grew quite suspicious of Chongche and sent Xue Zongyu to his army to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year Chang grew suspicious of Chongche and sent Xue Zongyu to inspect his army.

sentences.zh: 崇譽還，遂白崇徹日以伶人百餘衣錦繡、吹玉笛，為長夜之飲，不恤軍政。

translations.literal: When Chongyu returned, he reported that Chongche daily had more than a hundred entertainers dressed in brocade and satin, playing jade flutes, holding all-night drinking, and not caring for military government.
translations.idiomatic: When Chongyu returned, he reported that Chongche spent his days with more than a hundred entertainers in brocade, playing jade flutes and feasting through the night, heedless of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 鋹怒，召歸，奪其兵柄，自是居常怏怏。

translations.literal: Chang in anger summoned him back and stripped his military authority; from then on he lived in constant discontent.
translations.idiomatic: Chang in anger recalled him and stripped him of command. Thereafter he lived in constant resentment.

sentences.zh: 太祖命師度嶺，鋹復命崇徹領兵五萬戍賀江，崇徹不為效命。

translations.literal: Taizu ordered the army to cross the ranges; Chang again ordered Chongche to lead fifty thousand troops to garrison the He River, but Chongche would not render effective service.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizu ordered the army across the mountains, Chang again put Chongche in command of fifty thousand men on the He River, but Chongche would not fight effectively.

sentences.zh: 鋹敗，至京，太祖知其事，特赦之，授汝州別駕，卒。

translations.literal: When Chang was defeated and reached the capital, Taizu knew the circumstances and specially pardoned him, appointing him vice prefect of Ruzhou; [Chongche] died [in that post].
translations.idiomatic: After Chang's defeat, Chongche reached the capital. Taizu learned the circumstances, pardoned him specially, appointed him vice prefect of Ruzhou, and he died in that office.
